closure_rationale.schema: parent freezes CHA ownership and bijection, but not the exact durable CHA record
closure_rationale.source: parent requires authenticated exact LPPI operation; this child selects reuse of its complete verified immutable retained snapshot
closure_rationale.generation: parent does not select initial mapping generation or successor support
closure_rationale.timestamp: parent freezes ago UUIDv7 syntax, but does not select assignment UTC precision or timestamp correspondence
closure_rationale.durable_lifecycle: parent requires durable assignment before account reservation, but does not select crash cuts, exact-byte retry, filesystem protocol or capability reconstruction

canonicalization.canonical_utc: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ; exactly three fractional digits, real Gregorian UTC date, no offset or leap seconds

operation_identity.issuance: capture one internal actual UTC assignment instant; retain ago and exact source durably before commit or publication
operation_identity.uuid_timestamp: unsigned 48-bit floor(actual captured internal UTC assignment Unix epoch milliseconds); integer timedelta arithmetic, no float rounding, no uint48 masking
operation_identity.uuid_randomness: CSPRNG 12-bit rand_a and 62-bit rand_b; version 7 and RFC variant 10
operation_identity.assigned_at_uuid_timestamp_match: decode ago UUIDv7 timestamp and compare with exact millisecond assigned_at_utc

source_binding.derivation: derive seven semantic fields from exact verified retained LPPI binding; binding digest is lowercase hex SHA256(exact canonical LPPI binding bytes)
source_binding.retained_representation: lppi_operation_state_raw_hex is the complete exact canonical LPPI committed private snapshot obtained only after its source guard
source_binding.retained_signer_lineage: complete upstream snapshot retains authority binding digest/profile/fingerprint/custody, exact authority binding bytes, exact operation binding and signature; no duplicate signer fields are minted
source_binding.conflict_identity: exact complete retained LPPI snapshot bytes plus (pdsa_trust_domain, provisioning_operation_id); derived content digest alone is never authority
source_binding.source_binding_property: exact public LPPI binding after current upstream and committed CHA verification; transport alone grants no authority

bijection.registry_scope: one-entry initial installed CHA lifecycle; fixed machine state path in the same installed LPPI lifecycle directory
bijection.forward_uniqueness: one exact authenticated prvop can have only the retained ago
bijection.reverse_uniqueness: the sole retained ago can refer only to its exact retained authenticated prvop
bijection.immutability: reservation pins every field except status/history; committed exact record bytes cannot change

durable_lifecycle.publication: only after complete durable mapping commit and independently reverified exact source and retained record
durable_lifecycle.locks: one nonblocking cross-process state lock; reserve and commit are short critical sections, each validates the pinned record

storage.payload: exact RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 canonical record; exact upstream state encoded as lowercase hex
storage.durability: fsync temporary file before replacement; POSIX directory fsync after atomic replace, Windows MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH
storage.unsafe_files: reject symlink/reparse path, nonregular file, hardlink and oversized state

crash_retry.outcome: safe first reservation or fail-closed; no identifier published
resume exact retained ago, instant and upstream snapshot; never remint
resume exact pinned reservation after upstream requalification
return exact retained mapping after reverification; never remint
return exact committed mapping after reverification
restore upstream through its production loader, then verify existing committed CHA record; loader never creates or remints

durable_lifecycle.concurrency: racing process observes pinned/committed winner or stable bounded BUSY/retry; never a second ago for this initial lifecycle
durable_lifecycle.ambiguous_persistence_failure: do not publish; retry rereads and reconciles existing canonical durable state before any mint

cryptographic_boundary.authority: verified current upstream LPPI capability + CHA ownership + immutable durable mapping + private verifier-issued capability provenance

operation_capability.issuer: trusted installed CHA verifier only after durable bijection commit
operation_capability.restart: load_installed_cha_logical_operation accepts only newly reverified upstream capability and existing committed exact record; raw state cannot restore provenance

audit_reconciliation.historical_M05: retain original bytes and earlier NOT_FROZEN/DESIGN_BLOCKED findings; CHA owner is superseded by later topology ownership_resolution and ago syntax/ordering by frozen Stage9 parent
audit_reconciliation.not_superseded_by_this_child: account reservation, exact AccountGenesis canonical semantic request/root-proof closure, genuine account commit, independent freshness and business subject/account cardinality
audit_reconciliation.reuse: shared corrected UUIDv7 and existing hardened LPPI filesystem/locking primitives only; no CHA attempt store/root-proof authorization or legacy rows establish this boundary
